========================================================================
  PROVIDER : mailtrap (primary)
  subdomain: mailtrap.xprfire.site

Mailtrap generates its own SPF/DKIM records. In the Mailtrap dashboard:
  1) Sending Domains -> Add domain:  mailtrap.xprfire.site
  2) It shows 2-3 DNS records (SPF + DKIM, and possibly DMARC) - paste
     them 1:1 into your DNS provider. SPF will look like:
        v=spf1 include:spf.mailtrap.io ~all
  3) Once it verifies (green), generate an API token (Settings ->
     API Tokens) and put it in providers.json under the mailtrap slot.
  4) Send from e.g. hello@mailtrap.xprfire.site - free tier caps at
     150 emails/day (raise daily_cap if you upgrade to a paid plan).

=======================================================================

Then send from e.g. hello@<provider>.xprfire.site - the provider you pick for a
given subdomain must be the one whose SPF include that subdomain lists. Keys
are per-provider; never reuse a subdomain/key across providers. ADDITIONALLY:
publish one DMARC record so receivers know how to treat failed
authentication:

   Name :  _dmarc.xprfire.site
   Value:
   v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:dmarc@xprfire.site
